# Phase Transitions and Molecular Organization

A recurring theme in my research is understanding how molecular structure, intermolecular interactions, and packing determine phase behaviour and collective organization.

This interest has included liquid–solid transitions and polymorphism in triglycerides, molecular mechanisms underlying transformations between ordered liquid-crystalline phases, and, more recently, the persistence of local order above melting in semicrystalline polymers.

Across these different systems, a common question is how molecular organization develops, transforms, and can persist across phase transitions.
